rubric: unchecked-parse: JSON.parse on input that isn't validated or caught
swallowed-error: a catch block that drops the error
off-by-one: a loop bound or index that reaches one past the end
missing-await: a promise used without await where its result or failure matters
sql-concat: SQL built by concatenating outside input
secret-in-code: a credential or token written in source

findings.title: [P1] Mail failures are silently dropped
findings.body: The empty catch swallows every error from `mailer.send`, so callers believe the report went out. Rethrow or at least log.

findings.title: [P3] Consider structured logging here
findings.body: It may be worth wrapping this in the shared retry helper.

answer.overall_explanation: Errors from the mailer are discarded.
